collectible:1.text: Tarot cards are a mechanic in Cyberpunk 2077 and Phantom Liberty. They were also added in the Night City Tarot DLC for Cyberpunk RED. There are a total 34 tarot cards in Cyberpunk 2077, plus an additional 4 in Phantom Liberty. They first appear in Act 2 after V's mind becomes entangled with Johnny Silverhand's engram. In Cyberpunk 2077, 20 Major Arcanum tarot cards are linked to the quest Fool on the Hill.

collectible:3.text: Weapons are prevalent and varied throughout Night City, ranging from firearms to melee and cyberware. They are divided into the following subcategories: Weapons effectiveness is based on a tier system. The higher the tier, the more effective and expensive the weapons are. Tiers are tied to player level.

easter-egg:3.text: Cyberpunk 2.0.2.0., later subtitled, The Classic Roleplaying Game of the Dark Future, is the second edition of the popular pen and paper RPG series Cyberpunk. The Game was designed by Mike Pondsmith and was an updated version of the original Cyberpunk 2013 rule set. The Second edition was titled 2020 to reflect the updated setting of the year 2020.

easter-egg:6.text: This DR5 Nova, painted with a Maelstrom decal, is the signature weapon of Dum Dum. Doom Doom has an iconic modifier which allows it to fire 3 explosive rounds per shot. It gains 300% increased dismemberment chance at the cost of increased weapon spread and recoil.

easter-egg:9.text: Mike is best known for his work for the publisher R. Talsorian Games, where he developed a majority of the company's role-playing game lines since the company's founding in 1982. Pondsmith is credited as an author of several RPG lines, including Mekton (1984), Teenagers from Outer Space (1987), Cyberpunk: The Roleplaying Game of the Dark Future (1988) and Castle Falkenstein (1994).

easter-egg:11.text: A Tier 4 ultimate quickhack that cripples the enemy's nervous system, knocking them out without making a sound. Reducing trace progress reduces the RAM cost of System Collapse by 12. This effect can stack up to two times and lasts indefinitely until used. The Tier 5 variant reduces trace progress by 20% after neutralizing an enemy with System Collapse.
